import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p03-csv-evening-trips/shuttle_trips.csv')

# Convert departure and arrival to datetime
df['departure_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['departure'])
df['arrival_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['arrival'])

# Extract hour from departure
df['departure_hour'] = df['departure_dt'].dt.hour

# Calculate duration in minutes
df['duration_minutes'] = (df['arrival_dt'] - df['departure_dt']).dt.total_seconds() / 60

# Filter: departure at or after 18:00 (hour >= 18) AND duration > 90 minutes
filtered = df[(df['departure_hour'] >= 18) & (df['duration_minutes'] > 90)]

print("Trips departing at or after 18:00:")
evening_trips = df[df['departure_hour'] >= 18]
print(evening_trips[['trip_id', 'route', 'departure', 'arrival', 'duration_minutes']])

print("\nTrips departing at or after 18:00 AND taking longer than 90 minutes:")
print(filtered[['trip_id', 'route', 'departure', 'arrival', 'duration_minutes']])

print(f"\nCount: {len(filtered)}")
